# Planto

> Planto is a plant identification and care app. Snap a photo of a plant to identify it, detect plant diseases and pests, and get care guides and reminders.

Website: https://www.growplanto.com
App: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.plantgenius

## Key pages
- [Features](https://www.growplanto.com/features): Plant identification, care guides, smart reminders, disease detection, health monitoring and community support.
- [How it works](https://www.growplanto.com/how-it-works): Identify a plant in three steps.
- [Pricing](https://www.growplanto.com/pricing): Free plan (5 identifications per day), Pro ($4.99/month) and Lifetime ($49.99 one-time).
- [FAQ](https://www.growplanto.com/faq): Common questions about the app.
- [About](https://www.growplanto.com/about): The team and mission behind Planto.
- [Contact](https://www.growplanto.com/contact): Support and feedback.
